description: This file contains functions for creating and managing setup wizard status and input configurations related to binary detection and user prompts in a plugin-based system.

methods.name: createDetectedBinaryStatus
methods.description: Creates a status object for detecting a binary, including methods to resolve status lines, selection hints, and quickstart scores based on binary detection.

methods.name: createCliPathTextInput
methods.description: Creates a text input configuration for CLI path input with optional help lines and title.

methods.name: createDelegatedSetupWizardStatusResolvers
methods.description: Creates delegated resolver functions for status lines, selection hints, and quickstart scores by loading a wizard.

methods.name: createDelegatedTextInputShouldPrompt
methods.description: Creates a function to determine if a text input should prompt, delegated to a loaded wizard.
